title: Complete the CLI command reference
description:
docs/reference/cli-commands.md is billed as the complete command reference but ships empty stub sections (Document Commands; Status and Validation — README links into one), and omits entire command families: item, invariant, reference, apply, snapshot, hooks, top-level search, and even issue create and update.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-1: No empty stub sections remain
- [ ] [hard] REQ-2: issue create and issue update are documented
- [ ] [hard] REQ-3: The item, invariant, reference, apply, snapshot, hooks, and search families each have reference coverage
- [ ] [hard] REQ-4: Every anchor that other docs link into resolves
- [ ] [hard] REQ-5: Documented flags and arguments match the current CLI definitions
